name: Zach Hanley
biography: Zach Hanley has been hooked on exploit development and offensive security since introduced to the world of hacking as an On-Net Operator for DoD and IC organizations. He’s since developed implants and exploits for both the government and commercial sector. He currently is a vulnerability researcher and attack engineer for Horizon3.ai.
